title: LLMs can persuade only psychologically susceptible humans on societal issues, via trust in AI and emotional appeals, amid logical fallacies
reasoning: The paper investigates the psychological and social dynamics of persuasion by LLMs, focusing on human susceptibility, personality traits, and trust. While it discusses societal issues and polarizing topics like climate change and health misinformation, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theological frameworks, or formal ethical/moral systems.
